# The lamp pulse: a ring of light 3 m in radius (its largest; the game scales it down), its
# underside removed (unlit).
# Generated by make_models.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Light --base-color 1.0000 0.9333 0.5137 --no-slot --emission 1.0000 0.9333 0.5137
add mesh torus --name Ring --major-segments 72 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 3.0 --minor-radius 0.09 --location 0 0 0
scale 1 1 0.7
apply --scale
material assign Light
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.2"
delete only-faces
mode object
export ring.glb
